title: Malden man found guilty of trafficking women throughout Greater Boston
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Crime From July 2021 to March 2022, Yuen harbored women at his residence in Malden and transported them to hotels and residences in Greater Boston for commercial sex, the AG said.
A Malden man was found guilty of sex trafficking and money laundering on Friday, prosecutors announced.

Following a two-week trial, Eric Yuen, 58, of Malden, was found guilty of three counts of sex trafficking, one count of deriving support from prostitution, and one count of money laundering in Middlesex Superior Court, according to the Attorney General’s Office.

author: Madison Lucchesi
